enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn on back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket up. Lie still. Open eyes. Stretch arms. Sit up.

Stand up from bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up soap. Turn on water. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and pan. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread. Pour juice. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink juice. Clear table. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open door. Walk out. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Review chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Measure blood pressure. Record data. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to break room. Drink water.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Check phone. Finish meal. Clear tray. Walk to break room. Sit on couch. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check IV. Change dressing. Assist doctor. Take notes. Answer phone. Walk to lab. Pick up results. Deliver results to doctor. Walk to patient room. Talk to family. Update chart. Walk to nurse station. Sit down. Type notes. Answer call. Walk to supply room. Get supplies.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Close door. Lock door. Take off shoes. Put down bag. Walk to kitchen. Drink water.

Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Turn on stove. Pour oil. Cut vegetables. Put in pan. Add chicken. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Flip channels. Stop on a show. Watch. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back. Sit on couch. Drink. Watch TV.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Type password. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type. Scroll. Click. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Close browser. Open game. Play game.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Rinse. Scrub body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe slowly.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn on back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket up. Lie still. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Turn again. Lie still.
